text:
I left Israel together with my partner last year (we were planning to return later to finish up the paperwork, which didn't happen in the end). When I sent an email from abroad saying we were living abroad for the next year or so, they cancelled my visa immediately. So maybe theocratically not possible like Lior says, but doesn't mean it can't happen... Guess it depends on who answers your  question. Good luck! 
(I was on A5 in Haifa office)
